access_notes: Viewed 2026-11-07 (dress research for the 1812 scene). Watercolour on ivory miniature of an American man in a dark green coat with a high turned collar, a yellow waistcoat and a white neckcloth tied high.
note: Proposed for the 1812 dress reference sets; not a Chicago or Fort Dearborn record. Recorded by the 1812 dress build (officers-traders group) from the T-3461 dress research (docs/RESEARCH/people-1812-3461/dress.json new_sources).
what_it_supplies: an American man's coat, waistcoat and neckcloth colours in 1811
